english: Let $x$ be a real number such that the mean deviation about the median of the five observations $3,7,10,14,x$ is $4$. Then the sum of all possible values of $x$ is
hindi: माना $x$ एक वास्तविक संख्या है जिसके लिए पाँच प्रेक्षणों $3,7,10,14,x$ का माध्यिका के सापेक्ष माध्य विचलन $4$ है। तब $x$ के सभी सम्भव मानों का योग है
solution_full: The mean deviation about the median $M$ is $\dfrac15\sum|x_i-M|=4$, so $\sum|x_i-M|=20$.
The median is the third value in order, so it depends on where $x$ lies.
Case $x\le7$: the order puts $7$ third, $M=7$. Sum $=|3-7|+0+|10-7|+|14-7|+|x-7|=14+7-x=21-x$. Setting $21-x=20$ gives $x=1\le7$. Valid.
Case $7\le x\le10$: $M=x$. Sum $=(x-3)+(x-7)+(10-x)+(14-x)=14$, a constant, never $20$.
originality_note: New: the unknown observation moves the median itself, so the mean deviation about the median is a piecewise function of x with a flat middle piece and two solutions (way 2: a quantity defined by a moving point). Closest known: 'find the missing observation given the mean deviation'. Different because: the centre changes with x and the middle range gives no solution at all.
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Changed: No change.
key_step: Splitting by the position of x to fix the median, then solving each linear piece.
justification: Routine casework with three cases and no insight. Comparable to the case split of 2021-P1-Q17 (L1) but with more cases and a statistics layer, so Level 2.

concept_use.Mean deviation about the median: The sum of |x_i - M| with M depending on x is set equal to 20 in each case.
